description: Diagnostic (MCP Apps hosts only): mounts a view that instantiates a tiny hand-assembled WebAssembly module, computes per-frame state in it, renders to canvas, and captures arrow-key input -- the same three ingredients a WASM game port would need. Answers whether THIS host permits WASM execution inside a ui:// View iframe; it proves nothing about any other host or sandbox.
name: wasm_spike
